title: All phases of a fixed four-wave overlap and any finite separated mixed collection
statement: The completed Ultra final reports positive rank-one Hessian gluing for the all-amplitude/all-phase triad, a literal four-wave overlapping pattern with fixed relative amplitudes and all phases, and any finite collection of these two block types at scales 9^j. For every globally rank-one-convex polynomial with leading cF_star, c>0, the stated class has energy gap at least (c/200) times the averaged fourth power of the total gradient norm, for all means and stated proper output rotations. The overlapping potential is psi=e1*sin(x)+e2*sin(y)+(e1+e2)*sin(x+y-delta1)+(1/2,1/4)*sin(2*x+y-delta1-delta2); arbitrary delta1,delta2,mean M,overall scale rho and common proper output rotation; four relative amplitudes fixed. Its frequencies (1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(2,1) have two shared-mode cubic resonances and both coupled quartets. Eight positive rays match covariance and both cubic targets on all twelve admissible modes; two strictly positive phase matrices provide the uniform budget. Sixteen cross-block estimates and the literal 9^j separation remove mixed relations of degree at most four except opposite pairs, yielding the same c/200 bound for any finite mixed collection. The overlapping block does not have four independently variable relative amplitudes.
